method: Read-only review of exactly the lexically sorted first 33 web/tests paths from the frozen inventory.groups.web. Manually read the complete source, every fixture, test body and assertion in all 33 files; the longest files were read in complete bounded consecutive segments, and some reads suppressed blank lines only. This is semantic test review, not filename enumeration or only mapping/structural parsing. Traced the mocked transport boundaries, synthetic credential handling, explicit action consent, durable intent admission, original-operation receipt recovery without resubmission, incomplete/foreign receipt rejection, account/MCP OAuth private handoff ownership and invalidation, connection/runtime/thread scope changes and A-to-B-to-A races, draft ownership, configuration version rebasing, loaded-history and event reconciliation, attachment/project-path limits, media opt-in and object URL cleanup, resource capacities and malformed-input assertions. Cross-checked assertions against the runtime contracts and implementation reviewed in the same frozen runtime/protocol partition and read the complete current vitest.config.ts to establish mock restoration settings; the broader web implementation is independently reviewed by the web partition reviewer. No concrete test defect or implementation-contract contradiction was confirmed in this assigned scope. Read every assigned file again as bytes to check SHA256 against inventory.hashes; per-file hash, byte and line evidence is included. An optional esbuild resolver check returned MODULE_NOT_FOUND; no successful TSX parser or typecheck is claimed. No tests were executed for this partition and no source files were changed. Real browser layout, accessibility behavior and actual image/audio decoding are not established by these mocked/jsdom source assertions. No paid inference, real external MCP, online action, personal home/credential inspection, archived sibling implementation, or old Git implementation was used. Final node scripts/snapshot.mjs returned 1876 files with the unchanged frozen digest. This completes only the assigned 33-test partition and is not a whole-repository clean-round declaration.
